preconditions.name: enough_divergent_seeds
preconditions.description: number of seeds whose candidate pool is DIVERGENT on BOTH arms >= MIN_DIVERGENT_SEEDS. Per-seed-divergent gating; too few => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: consumed cand_world_summary pairwise spread > floor (GAP-A); per-seed

preconditions.name: loops_carry_live_cross_loop_variance
preconditions.description: ARC-110 NON-DEGENERACY guard: on BOTH loop arms a non-motor loop FLIPS the within-eligible winner or the loops DISAGREE on a non-trivial fraction of P2 ticks, AND a non-motor loop carries per-loop preference RANGE > 0, on a majority of seeds. A loop pinned to the motor winner is a vacuous split.
preconditions.control: loop_frac_committed_neq_motor / loop_frac_disagree + per-loop pref range (both arms)

preconditions.name: named_channel_routing_live
preconditions.description: 707b C2-release non-degeneracy: on the LEARNED arm at least one LIMBIC channel (ofc/liking/vigour) reaches the arbitration carrying routed per-candidate RANGE > LIMBIC_ROUTED_RANGE_FLOOR (peak over P2 ticks), on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. Without live limbic range the arbitration has no limbic signal to learn to route through (the MECH-191 phasic gap). measured = max across LEARNED seeds of the limbic routed range; SAME statistic (per-candidate range) the conversion depends on, not a magnitude proxy.
preconditions.control: LEARNED loop_limbic_routed_range_max (peak limbic routed per-candidate range over P2)

preconditions.name: learned_cross_loop_weights_moved_off_init
preconditions.description: ARC-108 x ARC-110 MECHANISM non-vacuity (W): on the LEARNED arm the learned cross-loop matrix M_cross MOVED off its zero init -- loop_cross_loop_m_range (per-tick) AND post_action_update clg_m_cross_range both > M_CROSS_RANGE_FLOOR AND clg_n_updates > 0 -- on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds. At init M_cross==0 -> W_cross==I -> LEARNED is BIT-IDENTICAL to STATIC; if the weights never moved a 'no lift' is meaningless => substrate_not_ready_requeue (NEVER a weakens). measured = max across LEARNED seeds of the peak M_cross range; SAME statistic (M_cross range) the mechanism depends on.

preconditions.name: limbic_loop_parity_win
preconditions.description: THE LOAD-BEARING gate (the 711 autopsy target), NOW SATURATION-GUARDED: on the A_ASCENDING_ON arm the limbic loop's effective column weight w_eff[limbic] (from the PARITY-CONTROLLED W_cross) reaches a FAIR PARITY WIN -- it enters the parity BAND (w_eff[motor] <= w_eff[limbic] <= PARITY_BAND_HI x w_eff[motor]) on >= 1 P2 tick AND does NOT blow up (w_eff/M_cross under the saturation ceiling) -- on a STRICT-MAJORITY (>= LIMBIC_WIN_PASS_FRACTION = 3/4) of DIVERGENT seeds. This is the exact repair of the 711 hole: the raw scalar met a BARE w_eff[limbic] >= w_eff[motor] via a 10-2274x MONOPOLY (saturation), which the band+ceiling now rejects. If the controller cannot deliver a fair parity win on >= 3/4 divergent seeds (lift too weak), the conversion question is not measured => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a weakens. measured = n divergent seeds with a fair parity win; SAME statistic (effective column weight) the conversion depends on.
preconditions.control: A_ASCENDING_ON clg_limbic_parity_win (band win AND not saturated) over P2

preconditions.name: no_saturation_blowup
preconditions.description: SATURATION GUARD (the load-bearing 711 repair): the number of DIVERGENT seeds on the A_ASCENDING_ON arm whose arbitration BLEW UP -- w_eff[limbic] peak past SATURATION_W_EFF_CEILING x w_eff[motor] peak, or M_cross range peak past SATURATION_M_CROSS_CEILING -- must be ZERO (upper-bound: measured <= threshold). Any saturated seed means a limbic MONOPOLY (not a fair win) and the conversion was tested under a degenerate arbitration => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a decisive FAIL/weakens. With a correctly tuned controller this is always 0.
preconditions.control: A_ASCENDING_ON clg_saturated count over divergent seeds (0 expected)

preconditions.name: learning_engaged_finer_channels_dissociable_delta_nonflat
preconditions.description: on BOTH arms the finer w_chan_finer entries MOVED + carry cross-channel range above floor AND the signed-RPE delta_t carries cross-tick variance, on a majority of seeds -- learning is engaged. Below floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward

config_summary.arms: A_ASCENDING_OFF (use_ascending_parity_controller=False -- the un-gained 709 learned-arbitration ceiling baseline) / A_ASCENDING_ON (use_ascending_parity_controller=True -- bounded target-parity controller: forward gain capped at the parity ceiling + clamped ascending M_cross maturation). Learned cross-loop arbitration ON on BOTH arms; the raw scalar (use_ascending_spiral_gain) OFF on BOTH.
config_summary.swept_variable: use_ascending_parity_controller ONLY (bounded forward parity-ceiling gain + clamped plasticity maturation on the ascending upper-triangular M_cross entries). Learned cross-loop arbitration + loop segregation + ARC-109 D1/D2 + MECH-452 loop-local traces + named-channel routing + limbic input modules + finer gating + learned settling ON on BOTH arms.
config_summary.the_isolated_factor: whether the ascending (strict-upper-triangle) M_cross entries are BOUNDED-GAINED by the parity controller: OFF runs W_cross = I + M_cross (the un-gained 709 learned combine); ON runs W_cross = I + (G(g) .* M_cross) where g is SOLVED per-step to hold w_eff[limbic] toward but under PARITY_CEILING_RATIO x w_eff[motor] (a fair parity, not a monopoly), and clamps the ascending M_cross maturation to +/- m_cross_clamp. Raises w_eff[limbic]/w_eff[assoc] WITHOUT touching w_eff[motor], bounded. At init M_cross==0 or inert params -> bit-identical to OFF.
config_summary.matched_constant_arithmetic_envelope: use_f_eligibility_demotion + use_f_eligibility_adaptive_floor (689e) + use_go_nogo_constitution (689g) + use_modulatory_selection_authority (643a) + use_modulatory_channel_routing (cand_world_summary) + top_k shortlist (k=3, 569i)
config_summary.matched_loop_substrate: use_loop_segregation=True + use_d1_d2_population_split + use_loop_local_eligibility_traces + use_named_channel_routing + use_ofc_analog + use_mech295_liking_bridge + use_tonic_vigor (the 707b C2-release stack: the limbic loop carries live per-candidate range on both arms)
config_summary.matched_diversity_stack: MECH-341 stratified + use_dacc + use_gated_policy + use_lateral_pfc_analog (trained P1 REINFORCE) + SD-056 all levers + matured/maintained CRF + use_candidate_rule_field + use_finer_channel_gating + use_learned_settling_step
config_summary.primary_dv: committed-action-class entropy (nats), interpreted on divergent seeds only
config_summary.phases: P0 e2-train (CRF matures) -> P1 frozen-encoder bias-head REINFORCE -> P2 e2+bias frozen; finer gating + loops + M_cross KEEP adapting
config_summary.learning_wiring: M_cross updated via e3.post_action_update driven by agent.update_residue every WAKING tick (MECH-094); shares the ARC-108 delta_t with w_chan_finer + W_lat; no autograd (register_buffer)
config_summary.reuse_note: both arms ride the in-flux learned-cross-loop / loop-segregation substrate -> neither minted as a reusable baseline (extra_ineligible_reasons set)
config_summary.safety: arbitration runs strictly within the F + MECH-448/449 Go/No-Go eligible set; a learned weight reorders within-eligible candidates but can never re-admit a suppressed one

interpretation_grid.PASS_ascending_spiral_gain_lifts_convers: preconditions met (divergent seeds + loops carry LIVE cross-loop variance + named-channel routing live + the M_cross weights MOVED off init on the ON arm + the LOAD-BEARING gate: the ascending gain lets the limbic loop reach >= motor effective weight on >= 3/4 divergent seeds + learning engaged) AND C1 (A_ASCENDING_ON committed-class entropy strict-above A_ASCENDING_OFF + margin on a strict-majority of divergent seeds). Once a non-motor loop CAN win, the ascending spiral gain CONVERTS committed-action diversity where the un-gained 709 learned arm could not -> the F-dominance conversion ceiling is LIFTABLE (weakens MECH-439), via ARC-108 learned gating at the ARC-110 cross-loop arbitration (supports both). First evidence that a strengthened ascending spiral lifts the loop-effective-weight ceiling.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_ascending_spiral_gain_lets_limbic_w: DECISIVE. preconditions met (the M_cross MOVED, and the ascending gain DID lift the limbic loop to >= motor effective weight on >= 3/4 divergent seeds -- the load-bearing gate MET, loops live) BUT A_ASCENDING_ON still does NOT lift committed-class entropy strict-above A_ASCENDING_OFF. Even when a non-motor loop CAN win the arbitration, committed-action diversity does NOT convert -> the F-dominance conversion ceiling is INTRINSIC (supports MECH-439); the ARC-108 x ARC-110 loop-arbitration route does not deliver (weakens both).
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: A precondition is unmet: too FEW divergent seeds, OR the loops carry NO live cross-loop variance, OR the NAMED limbic channels carry NO routed per-candidate range (MECH-191 phasic gap -- limbic loop inert), OR the M_cross weights did NOT move off init on the ON arm, OR the LOAD-BEARING gate is unmet (even WITH the ascending gain the limbic loop reached >= motor effective weight on FEWER than 3/4 divergent seeds -- the gain needs strengthening), OR learning was not engaged / CRF not matured. The conversion question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification.
